title: Create a TypeScript Library
description: Create a TypeScript library under `libs/<domain>[/<subdomain>...]/[<group>/]<type>`, or `tools/[<group>/]<type>` for `--scope=tools`, wrapping `@nx/js:library` with the workspace naming, directory, and tag conventions (ADR 0009). Restricted to the framework-agnostic `type:` values (`models`, `testing`, `types`, `utils`) — Angular-only types are out of scope, and backend types (`api`, `services`, `infra`) are rejected because backend libraries are .NET projects created with `dotnet new` (ADR 0017).

examples.description: Generates `nx-testing` at `tools/nx/testing`, tagged `scope:tools,type:testing` — tools projects are domain-exempt, so `--domain` is not accepted.

type.description: The project's `type:` tag and the final directory segment. Restricted to the types that are genuinely framework-agnostic — `core`/`feature`/`ui`/`data-access` are Angular-only, so they don't belong behind this generator. The backend types `api`, `infra` and `services` are listed only so the generator can reject them with a pointer to `dotnet new` (ADR 0017).

domain.description: The product domain (and optional `/`-separated subdomains, e.g. `billing/checkout`) this library belongs to. Required for every `--scope` except `tools` — a `libs/` project is never domain-exempt, while a `tools/` project always is, so `--domain` is rejected for `--scope=tools` (ADR 0009).

scope.description: The project's `scope:` tag. Required — `models`/`testing`/`types`/`utils` are scope-polymorphic (ADR 0009) so this must be given explicitly. `tools` places the project under `tools/[<group>/]<type>` with no `domain:` tag.

group.description: An optional label distinguishing this library from siblings of the same type within its domain. Omittable for a domain-singleton type; expected from the first library for a type that's typically many-per-domain (`utils`, `testing`) to avoid a rename later (ADR 0009).

name.description: Literal project-name override passed straight through to `@nx/js:library`. When given, it replaces the derived name; the directory is still derived from `domain`/`group`/`type`.

bundler.description: The bundler to use. Choosing 'none' means this library is not buildable.

linter.description: The tool to use for running lint checks.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner to use for unit tests. The workspace standardizes on Jest (ADR 0007). `none` is rejected for `scope:shared`, which needs the `typecheck` target that only a test runner brings (issue #164).

tags.description: Additional freeform tags appended to the generated `scope:`/`type:`/`domain:` tags, comma-separated.

publishable.description: Configure the library ready for use with `nx release`.

importPath.description: The library name used to import it, like `@cybertecpty/my-lib`. Required for a publishable library.

useProjectJson.description: Use a `project.json` configuration file instead of inlining the Nx configuration in the `package.json` file.

enableTypedLinting.description: Whether to enable typed linting. We do not enable this by default for lint performance reasons (ADR 0006).

skipTsConfig.description: Do not update `tsconfig.json` for development experience.

skipTypeCheck.description: Whether to skip TypeScript type checking for the SWC compiler.

includeBabelRc.description: Include a `.babelrc` configuration to compile TypeScript files.

testEnvironment.description: The test environment to use if `unitTestRunner` is `jest`.

minimal.description: Generate a library with a minimal setup. No `README.md` generated.
